title: Dental Crowns Cost Santa Clarita: 2026 Prices and Guide
seoTitle: Dental Crowns Cost in Santa Clarita: Prices and Guide
seoDescription: What a crown costs in Santa Clarita, how material and lab work change the price, and how insurance helps. Ask our Valencia office for an itemized estimate.
excerpt: Material, lab fees and case complexity set crown prices. See typical local ranges by crown type, ways to lower out-of-pocket cost, and what to expect visit by visit.
keyTakeaways: Three things drive crown pricing: material and lab fees, clinical complexity, and practice overhead.
The article cites all-ceramic crowns at $900 to $2,200 and porcelain-fused-to-metal at $800 to $1,600 locally.
A post, core, root canal or implant adds separate fees on top of the crown itself.
Many plans pay a percentage after a waiting period; request a pre-treatment estimate before starting.
With good care crowns commonly last 10 to 15 years; a night guard helps if you grind your teeth.
